issues.extracted: Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis (p1): Restricted for ... / Unrestricted 7,891,378
issues.on_page: Statement of Assets and Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p3-4), Total Governmental Funds: Restricted lines; Committed for Road maintenance 17,901; Unassigned 7,873,477; total 9,580,910
issues.issue: Under the 2026-10-27 balance-sheet rule, a cash-basis report whose governmental funds statement totals match the government-wide figures (9,580,910 on both) takes its lines from the governmental funds statement, with fund balance by classification. The JSON uses the p1 government-wide statement, so Committed 17,901 and Unassigned 7,873,477 are missing and Unrestricted 7,891,378 is used instead. The p1 amounts themselves are correct.
issues.resolution: fixed 2026-10-27: balance sheet switched to the p4 Total Governmental Funds column (8 Restricted lines, Committed: Road maintenance 17,901, Unassigned 7,873,477; totals 9,580,910 unchanged)

issues.on_page: Non-Major combining statement, 9 fund columns plus Total
issues.issue: The detail rule says a combining schedule with more than 6 funds should use its Total column with fund 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'. Recording per fund is more detailed and every amount checks, but it doesn't follow the rule.

issues.on_page: 911 Emergency Services Local 18,133 (p2: Public safety charges for services 18,133)
issues.issue: The statement of activities identifies this exact amount as public-safety charges for services, so charges for services/fees fits better than 'other'.

Every other 'Local' line uses detail_category 'Other / Miscellaneous Receipts' under the user decision, but this one uses 'miscellaneous revenue'. Preservation and modernization receipts are register-of-deeds fees, so fees of office would fit better.
The label names an object of expenditure, so 'employee benefits and payroll taxes' fits better than 'not itemized'.
